title: PEM-encoded private key: must be flagged (provider-documented)
summary: Synthetic PEM-encoded private key values built to the documented format appear in 2 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Locally parseable Ed25519 PKCS#8 private key from a fixed public test seed. Never deployed; not a provider-issued credential.
